a.xlink:title: Emitted after the card-database update subprocess exits.
Posts a tray notification when the status bar cannot show progress.
Emitted while the card-database update subprocess runs. progress.done/progress.total are byte counts ...
Parses one line of the updater stdout protocol: "PROGRESS <stage> <done> <total>".
Loads card databases from configured paths, using the binary cache when valid.
